mcq_fix.s: Which of the following correctly describes the distribution of women workers in India by category in Census 2011?
o: About 24% of women workers were agricultural labourers and 24% were cultivators
About 55% of women workers were agricultural labourers and 24% were cultivators
About 55% of women workers were cultivators and 24% were agricultural labourers
About 12.8% of women workers were agricultural labourers and 55% were cultivators
mcq_fix.why: 55%/24% are shares of women workers by category, not women's share of all labourers/cultivators (women are ~43% of agri labourers)

mcq_drop.why: statement on Visakhapatnam household-industry share is unsupported/unverifiable; key rests on it

patterns: Genuine APPSC items here are few and data-driven: share of workforce in agriculture (48.9% in 2011-12, NSS) and AP district extremes (Chittoor = cultivators, West Godavari = agricultural labourers).
APPSC Group-2 uses 'which is not true' statement sets with Census/NSS percentages; traps are swapped 2001 vs 2011 figures and services share.
Most PYQs filed here are misfiled (population, agriculture, disasters) or mental ability; core worker-definition questions (183 days, WPR denominator) come mostly from other PSCs.
App MCQs are heavy on 2025-26 PLFS figures and multi-number options; APPSC tends to ask one figure or one district at a time with an AP tilt.
Key AP facts worth drilling: MGNREGA launched at Bandlapalli (Anantapur) 2 Feb 2006; agricultural labourers ~48% of AP workers; AP WPR above national.
